name: Fruit
author: dashiell10
description: Go up at 41% above the saw (to the area where your icon will touch the key) and then hold to the ceiling between the slope and spikes. Move down at 45%, touch the dash orb and then spam in between the invisible moving platforms until 46.4% where you can move to the ceiling. Go in the middle of the level from 47.1%-47.9% to avoid a saw on the ceiling and then hold back to the ceiling. Move to the floor shortly after passing the dash orb at 50% and stay there. Stay on the floor until the end from there.
